purpose: Turn the concept package into ten commissionable pre-G3 work packages with owners, professions, deliverables, dependencies, acceptance definitions, and no-go triggers.
claim_boundary: The participant-authored briefs are complete enough to scope appointment and desktop review. No professional is appointed, no external evidence is received, no budget or procurement is approved, and no field work or G3 pilot is authorised.

readiness_ladder.meaning: concept rules, evidence templates, and synthetic replay
ten participant-authored commissioning briefs and acceptance/no-go definitions
authorised appointments, surveys, professional findings, quantities, quotations, and sign-offs
procurement, construction, live data, recruited participation, and G3 field pilot

packages.title_zh: 正式几何与资料请求包
packages.prepared_output: field-by-field request register, source/rights/CRS checklist, and whole-package recalculation trigger
external_inputs_required: control lines, existing-condition and engineering datasets
packages.acceptance_definition: each dataset has authority, version/date, rights, CRS, completeness result, and linked recalculation receipt
packages.no_go_trigger: authority, rights, CRS, geometry validity, or required layer is unresolved

packages.title_zh: 责任机构与授权确认包
packages.prepared_output: RC-by-RC nomination, mandate, conflict, delegate, pause-right, liability, and replacement-route template
packages.acceptance_definition: all RC accountable roles and delegates are confirmed in writing with pause and replacement authority
packages.no_go_trigger: any RC lacks an authorised accountable institution, delegate, pause right, or liability route

packages.title_zh: 权属文保与轨道保护包
packages.prepared_output: constraint schedule linking every prototype and reversible component to rights, heritage, and rail review questions
packages.acceptance_definition: each spatial carrier is cleared, conditioned, moved, or removed with a signed reason and drawing reference
packages.no_go_trigger: uncleared right, heritage conflict, rail-protection conflict, or missing competent review

packages.title_zh: 实测消防无障碍与人流包
packages.title_en: Survey, fire, accessibility, and crowd review
packages.prepared_output: survey brief and route/interface schedule for boundaries, levels, widths, egress, bypass, servicing, and crowd conditions
packages.acceptance_definition: all public/test routes and service positions have measured values, findings, correction owner, and closure state
packages.no_go_trigger: basic passage, egress, emergency access, accessible continuity, or crowd safety cannot be demonstrated

packages.title_zh: 市政防洪能源与网络容量包
packages.title_en: Utilities, flood, energy, and network capacity
packages.prepared_output: load-and-interface request sheet with degraded mode, isolation, maintenance, removal, and reinstatement checks
packages.acceptance_definition: each proposed service stack has verified capacity, isolation, maintenance, fallback, and reinstatement decision
packages.no_go_trigger: capacity is unknown, unsafe, unavailable, unmaintainable, or lacks isolation and fallback

packages.title_zh: 数据隐私AI安全与网络审查包
packages.title_en: Data, privacy, AI-safety, and cyber review
packages.accountable_role_type: data controller and test-site operator role types
packages.prepared_output: S01-S12 data-flow, minimum-data, human-final-accountability, incident, withdrawal, and stop/resume review matrix
packages.acceptance_definition: each scenario has lawful purpose/authority, minimum fields, access/retention, human override, stop drill, incident and deletion receipt
packages.no_go_trigger: authority, minimum-data boundary, human control, isolation, withdrawal, deletion, or incident closure fails

packages.title_zh: 公共利益与经同意共测包
packages.prepared_output: paper-first notice, recruitment, consent, no-account route, task, withdrawal, barrier, repair, re-test, and appeal templates
packages.acceptance_definition: approved plan covers at least 12 consented route tasks and three need types, with withdrawal, correction, and independent sign-off
packages.no_go_trigger: service entitlement is conditioned on participation or consent, safety, access, withdrawal, or independent review is unavailable

packages.title_zh: 工程量规格与全生命周期成本包
packages.prepared_output: RC-by-RC measurable-item, unit, specification, quotation, capital, operation, maintenance, removal, reinstatement, and contingency template
external_inputs_required: at least two comparable quotations or approved rate basis
price date, tax, risk, and contingency basis
packages.acceptance_definition: every L1/L2 item has measured quantity, reviewed specification, price basis, lifecycle split, owner, and reinstatement provision
packages.no_go_trigger: quantity, specification, price basis, lifecycle owner, removal, or reinstatement provision is missing

packages.title_zh: 采购保险运营与区域接口包
packages.title_en: Procurement, insurance, operation, and regional interfaces
packages.prepared_output: procurement/appointment route, service levels, roster, maintenance, insurance, complaints, closure, and five-interface confirmation template
external_inputs_required: five counterpart confirmations and data licences
packages.acceptance_definition: operator, procurement, insurance, maintenance, complaint, closure, and each regional interface are signed and resourced
packages.no_go_trigger: operator, procurement authority, insurance/liability, maintenance, closure funding, or interface confirmation is missing

packages.title_en: Integrated go/no-go and G2 drill pack
packages.prepared_output: issue register, dependency check, RC drill script, stop/appeal/rollback receipts, residual-risk decision, and G3 authorisation checklist
external_inputs_required: closed major issues and funded reinstatement route
packages.acceptance_definition: C01-C09 accepted, all severe/major issues closed, six RC drills passed with independent sign-off, and an authorised G3 decision recorded
packages.no_go_trigger: any dependency, severe/major issue, stop/appeal/rollback drill, signatory, or reinstatement route remains open
